item.content:encoded: I do agree about the D-Class note kinda needing to be updated, but I like the object itself. I'm a big fan of the scips that are simply strange. I think the Foundation's world just being kind of odd is good - if EVERYTHING is dangerous and world-ending, it kinda becomes a farce instead of a complex and interesting world where sometimes the weird is ALSO dangerous. These 'ordinary' anomalies set the stage for the really screwed up ones.

I'm with Yeller. This one is showing its age. I'd down vote and call for a re-write, but I'm prevented in doing so by the warm fuzzy feeling I have inside over an SCiP that's completely benign and safe, and isn't trying to kill you or drive you slowly crazy.

…then again, a re-write could preserve that, too.

No vote.

item.content:encoded: Class Ds have gone from mostly violent criminals from death row to primarily a mix of political prisoners some tinpot dictator sold us and luckless civilians who got volunteered to help the Foundation, and terminations have gone from "monthly mass executions" to "frequent rotations so the Ds don't develop attachments between themselves or the staff." They're mostly regarded as expendable, but not casually expendable.
